words.meaning: to do a planned task, test, or investigation
words.example: We will carry out a survey next month.

words.meaning: to start or establish an organization or system
words.japaneseMeaning: 設立する・仕組みを作る
words.example: They want to set up a local reading group.

words.meaning: to delay something until a later time
words.example: We had to put off the trip because of the storm.

sentencePractice.prompt: The trip cannot happen tomorrow. We need to ____ the trip until next month.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The new later date explicitly requires postponement.

words.meaning: to take action to manage a problem or situation
words.example: The support team will deal with your request.

words.meaning: to accept a new task or responsibility
words.example: I can't take on any more work this week.

words.meaning: to take further action after an earlier event
words.example: I'll follow up with an email after our call.

words.meaning: to stay aware of changes or the position of something
words.example: This app helps me keep track of my spending.

words.meaning: to finish work by the required time
words.japaneseMeaning: 締め切りに間に合わせる
words.example: We need a clear plan to meet a deadline this tight.

words.meaning: to learn how to do a new job or activity
words.japaneseMeaning: 仕事などの要領を覚える
words.example: A colleague helped me learn the ropes during my first week.

words.meaning: to make an activity or process start
words.japaneseMeaning: 物事を動き始めさせる
words.example: Let's get the ball rolling by choosing a date.
